relationships.subject: APV
relationships.evidence_quote: After APV administration in the cACC, we observed significantly decreased duration of grooming and freezing (p < 0.01, Fig. 2C), reduced expression of NR2B and p-NR2B, and downregulated rate of glucose metabolism

relationships.subject: dental pulp injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, we also observed that NR2B expression level was increased in DPI group compared with sham group.

key_findings: Brain glucose metabolism peaks on day 3 after dental pulp injury and normalizes by day 14.
NR2B in the caudal ACC mediates toothache-related affective behaviours; APV in cACC reduced grooming/freezing.
